quests.title: Helen's Special Blend

dialogue.t: Oh, did you see the commission I put up? Finally, someone willing to help.
Have you gathered the ten Sweet Flowers?
Thank you so much. Please take this as thanks for your help.
I'll use them to brew some tea. Hopefully, that'll do my throat some good...

quests.description: Helen from Mondstadt needs 10 Sweet Flowers.
